svg.title: Digital pedal: audio path and power
svg.desc: J1 input jack into a TL072 voltage follower biased at 4.5 volt, then C3 into the PCM1808 VINL. PCM1808 SCK, BCK, LRC, OUT to ESP32 GPIO0, 26, 25, 19. ESP32 GPIO22 to PCM5102A DIN; BCK and LRCK shared with the PCM5102A. PCM5102A SCK to ground. PCM5102A LOUT through R5 1 kilohm to the RV8 master volume pot, wiper to the J2 output jack. Power: 9 volt DC jack J3, D1 1N5817, C5 100 microfarad, AMS1117-5.0 regulator to 5 volt. The TL072 runs on 9 volt.
svg.text: Digital pedal: audio path and power
ESP32 is the I2S clock master (12.288 MHz MCLK on GPIO0). ESP32 pins drawn in logical order.
Jumpers on the back: FLT L, DEMP L,
XSMT H, FMT L. SCK to GND = internal PLL.
U4 TL072 runs on 9V. ESP32, PCM1808 and PCM5102A run on 5V; the ESP32 makes the 3V3.
C6 10 µF on the regulator input only if the module has none. 100 nF (C8-C10) at the U1, U2, U3 power pins.
